# Third-Party Source Checkouts

`agent-runtime/` is a Git submodule pinned to the standalone Rust agent runtime
repository. Update runtime crates, schemas, fixtures, CLI, and evals in that
repository first, then advance this submodule pointer in NaviWealth.

`nsh-platform-android/` vendors the Apache-2.0 crates.io 0.4.0 release from
https://github.com/longbridge/nsh. The local patch exposes `app_data_root()`
on the engine thread, carrying the absolute directory that `NshView` already
obtains from `Context.getFilesDir()`. Only `src/lib.rs` and `src/host.rs` differ
from upstream; `.cargo/config.toml` applies this patch to both Cargo workspaces
(including the runner generated by nsh). Keep it until upstream provides this
native storage-path API. Do not edit generated files in `apps/client/.nsh/`.
